title: Human Factors
description: Human Factors as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are crew and maintainer tasks involving the installation identified?
Are human error risks in operation and maintenance identified?
Are anthropometric and access needs identified?
Are controls, labels and markings defined for the identified tasks?
Is access assessed for the reach and posture of the maintainer population?
Are mis-assembly risks mitigated by design (for example keyed or handed fittings)?
Are markings, placards and labels specified on the released definitions?
Are mis-assembly and mis-connection preventions confirmed in the detail design?
Are human factors evaluations complete or planned for crew-facing items?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
